_comment: BUILD CONFIGURATION ONLY - NOT an importable workflow template. The HTTP node and notification node export shapes are NOT verified for this org; build this in the Workflow Builder UI from this map. edison-org-for-test ONLY; set the trigger part filter AND severity filter before publishing. The Execute Code bodies are in code/ (build_request.py, validate_response.py, reverse_severity.py, notify_policy.py) and are covered by tests/part3/test_part3.py.
title: DevRevU Part 3 - HTTP works.create + reverse severity

trigger.filter: REQUIRED: dedicated Part 3 test part AND severity == 'low'

nodes.notes: Builds the works.create JSON via json.dumps. owned_by must be an ARRAY of user DONs - map the trigger owned_by objects to their .id.

nodes.auth: Use an ACTIVE sandbox Auth Token CONNECTION (Bearer). NEVER paste a raw token into the node or this repo.
nodes.idempotency: Body carries external_ref 'devrevu-p3:<ticket id>' to MITIGATE duplicates (not exactly-once). Prefer: check for an existing work with that external_ref BEFORE create, or handle a 409 conflict explicitly. Do NOT blindly POST-retry.
nodes.response_capture: Capture status_code and the full JSON body in the node outputs. Configure the DOWNSTREAM output mapping from an ACTUAL captured sandbox response - the real works.create response field path for work.id/display_id MUST be verified in the sandbox (no committed sample).

nodes.notes: RAISES on non-2xx OR missing work.id/display_id so a non-2xx HTTP finish becomes a FAILED run. Never leaks body/token. Verify the real response field path and set outputs from the actual response.
Comment goes on the CREATED ISSUE (work_id from validate_response).

nodes.note: Screenshot deliverable asks for comments on BOTH ticket and issue, so also post an internal comment on the originating ticket.

body.value: Linked issue {% expr $get('validate_response','output').display_id %} created for this ticket.

nodes.notes: Optional supported enhancement: link the Ticket to the created Issue if a link operation is available in your org.

nodes.message: {% expr $get('validate_response','output').display_id %} has been created for your ticket.
nodes.notes: notify_policy.py enforces 'notify only after a verified create' and produces the exact message/comment bodies. Use the real display_id from the validated response. Notification node export shape is NOT verified - configure in UI.
